mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates and reduced risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return correlation with FEDFUNDS is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity market returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return correlation with FEDFUNDS > 2.5% is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL) creates a negative feedback loop on equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return correlation with the interaction term of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return correlation with UNRATE > 4.0% is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return correlation with HOUST is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return correlation with HOUST < 1200 is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

failure_condition: The 20-day forward return correlation with the interaction term of PAYEMS and UNRATE is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
